scientific_status.orbittrace_result_if_successful: target-label-sealed recovery/rediscovery, not prospective unknown discovery

single_method_identity.candidate_generation: year-blind HDBSCAN EOM and leaf memberships at global and fixed overlapping 10-degree solar-longitude scales
single_method_identity.recurrence_calibration: fixed-membership year-label exchangeability; exact hypergeometric for two years and 9999 deterministic multivariate-hypergeometric draws for more than two years
single_method_identity.multiplicity: Benjamini-Yekutieli q-values across the deduplicated catalogue
single_method_identity.cross_scale_deduplication: Jaccard >= 0.80, retaining the best calibrated representative
single_method_identity.ranking: q-value, p-value, recurrence z, recurrence ratio, membership probability, size, family ID
single_method_identity.membership: leave-one-year-out robust halo with density FDR q<=0.10, followed by D<=0.15 orbital gate

ordered_gates.1_fair_literature: strictly exceed archived macro-F1 and match-or-exceed recovered-family count on all 4 Sugar/HDBSCAN panels
ordered_gates.2_clean_room_d_criterion: strictly exceed D-criterion macro-F1 and match-or-exceed recovered-family count on all 4 panels
ordered_gates.3_controls: no major regression under the frozen v2 control definitions
ordered_gates.4_orbittrace: one ranked family has 95/95 target recall, precision >= 0.75, F1 >= 0.85, rank <= 100
ordered_gates.5_independent_survey: run one untouched AMOS survey only after gates 1-4 pass

stopping_rule: Do not expose OrbitTrace or AMOS to a v3 variant that fails an earlier gate. Any parameter or semantic change creates a new version and requires rerunning earlier gates.
